subject: EdgeStream onboarding: evidence & DPA amendment request
messages:
From: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@finserve.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finserve.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New subprocessor: EdgeStream - onboarding questions

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. Our security team flagged that Redwood has added a new subprocessor, EdgeStream, to the vendor roster. Before we sign the DPA amendment can you provide the following for our review?

- Short data-flow diagram showing exactly what EdgeStream processes and where (EU/US/APAC).
- Confirmation whether EdgeStream will see raw customer inputs (PII) or only cached derivatives.
- SOC 2 or ISO 27001 attestation (PDF) and date of last audit.
- Whether there is SFTP or log access for customer support audits, and retention periods for those logs.
- A copy/Link to the DPA amendment and any DocuSign routing id so procurement can track.

We need to get this to legal and procurement by EOD Wednesday to avoid delaying our go-live.

Thanks,
Anna Lewis
Security Operations Manager
FinServe Inc.

Thanks for the note and the timeline heads-up. Looping in Kimberly (vendor security) and Rishi (privacy/ops) to provide the evidence and the short answers. We can hit EOD Wednesday.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@finserve.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New subprocessor: EdgeStream - onboarding questions

Hi Anna / team,

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, details below:

- Processing scope: EdgeStream is used as an edge caching and delivery layer for generated outputs. They do not perform model inference or training. Processing is limited to stored output artifacts and transient KV cache entries; raw input text is not persisted to EdgeStream beyond ephemeral TTLs (48 hours by default).
- Data residency: Primary processing occurs in US regions, with EU POPs (Ireland, Frankfurt) for lower-latency caching. No replicas are stored in APAC for this onboarding.
- Access to raw inputs: No. EdgeStream receives hashed keys and cached payloads for routing and delivery. We maintain a strict gating layer that filters raw input before EdgeStream exposure.
- Logs/SFTP: We provide customers with an SFTP export of access logs on request (7-10 business days to provision). Retention: access logs 90 days, debug traces 30 days.
- Certifications: Attached SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted) and a short onboarding summary (EdgeStream_onboarding_summary.pdf). We also attached a simplified data-flow (EdgeStream_dataflow.svg).
- DPA amendment: Weve prepared an amendment to incorporate EdgeStream as a subprocessor. DocuSign routing id: DS-EDGE-2026-11-16 (link below). The amendment limits EdgeStream access and requires prior notice for any material changes.

Attachments: EdgeStream_onboarding_summary.pdf; EdgeStream_dataflow.svg; DPA_Amendment_EdgeStream_Docusign.pdf (summary).

Related links: https://docusign.com/issue/abc123 
Jira ops ticket: OPS-2891 (for provisioning SFTP exports).

If you want, we can redact the SOC2 further for shared reporting constraints; happy to coordinate with your security lead.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Security Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@finserve.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finserve.com

Kimberly / Hannah,

This is great, thanks for the quick turn. A couple quick follow-ups before we finalize:

- Can you confirm the gating/filtering layer you mentioned is under Redwood control (not EdgeStream) and whether it is subject to RBAC + KMS-protected storage? We need the exact control owner for our compliance register.
- For the SFTP exports: is there a standard SLT for provisioning and will provisioning be logged in an audit trail we can reference?
- Procurement would like the DocuSign packet and a point of contact for signature questions (well likely sign the DPA amendment but want to confirm the SLA language on log retention).

If you can send the tiny addendum to the DocuSign with the gating owner line and expected SFTP lead time, we can route to legal and procurement today.

Thanks,
Anna
